 KUALA LUMPUR: The service matters of Malaysian Border Control and Protection Agency (AKPS) director-general Comm Datuk Seri Mohd Shuhaily Mohd Zain are still being finalised, says the Home Ministry.
 The ministry said it acknowledged and appreciated public views on the matter.
 “The service matters involving the AKPS director-general are currently in the process of being finalised. The ministry will ensure that the matter is handled in an orderly manner in accordance with the prevailing rules and procedures,” it said in a statement on Wednesday (Oct 28).
 The ministry said the establishment of AKPS, which is approaching its second year, was aimed at strengthening the management of the country's border control and protection.
 It added that AKPS played an important role in strengthening border security, ensuring smooth operations, protecting national revenue, and upholding integrity and discipline.
 “The ministry's priority is to ensure that AKPS continues to carry out its role optimally to safeguard the country's security and sovereignty,” it said.
 The ministry also said it would take into account operational continuity and the smooth execution of duties when managing officers' service matters.
